snippet.title: ZPF - Launch Trailer - Now Available for Sega Genesis/Mega Drive
snippet.description:
#ZPF has officially arrived — and it’s ready for your #SegaGenesis/#MegaDrive! 🚀

Dive headfirst into a cosmic gauntlet of 16-bit chaos, screen-shaking boss battles, pulse-pounding chiptunes, and secrets lurking in every corner. Built from the ground up as a love letter to the golden age of shoot-’em-ups, ZPF pushes the Genesis hardware to its limits.

✨ Play as Knight, Gladius, or Gold — each with their own playstyle
 🪐 Blast through surreal worlds blending fantasy, sci-fi, and horror
 💥 Face massive bosses that will test your reflexes (and your sanity)
 🔍 Discover hidden routes, secrets, and bonus challenges
 🎶 Experience a high-energy FM-powered soundtrack crafted for pure retro adrenaline

#ZPF is no longer just a trailer—it's now available for purchase! #SHMUP

Get your copy now: https://bit.ly/ZPFPhysicalRelease
More about the game here: https://bit.ly/MCS-ZPF
Mega Cat Studios Games & Updates: https://megacatstudios.com/
Join our Discord and hang out with us: https://discord.gg/megacat
